sparkCluster.help: Where a Spark script runs and is validated when its source names no cluster of its own. A source's own cluster is always used when it has one.
sparkCluster.addressHelp: The cluster's Spark Connect address, for example sc://spark.example.com:15002. Leave the token out of it: keep the token as a secret and name it below.
sparkCluster.credentialHelp: A secret reference to the token the cluster is called with, for example ${secret:spark_token}. Leave empty for a cluster that takes no token.
sparkCluster.inUseOrg: Sources that name no cluster use this default ({{target}}).
sparkCluster.inUseLocal: Sources that name no cluster use the local test cluster ({{target}}). Set a default to use your own cluster.
sparkCluster.inUseNone: No Spark cluster is configured: a source that names none cannot run until a default is set.
sparkCluster.hostHelp: The host name or address of the cluster's Spark Connect server, without sc:// or a port.
sparkCluster.tlsHelp: Connect over TLS. A token is only sent over TLS, so giving a token turns it on.
sparkCluster.userIdHelp: The user the cluster runs the script as, when it asks for one. Optional.
sparkCluster.badHost: A host name or address, without sc://, a port or a path
sparkCluster.pasteHelp: An sc:// address, such as sc://spark.example.com:15002/;use_ssl=true. It is split into the fields; a token in it is kept as a secret.
sparkCluster.pasteToken: The address carries a token. It is kept as an organization secret and the cluster names that secret; the token itself is not kept in the address.
sparkCluster.pasteSecretHelp: The organization secret the token is kept in. A secret of this name is replaced.
sparkCluster.pasteKeep: Keep the token as a secret
sparkCluster.storedUnread: The cluster kept for this source cannot be read: {{problem}}

notAddress.scheme: {{part}} is not a Spark Connect address: it starts with sc://
notAddress.port: {{part}} is not a port from 1 to 65535

sparkCluster.blankUsesOrg: Left blank, this source runs on the organization's default Spark cluster ({{target}}).
sparkCluster.blankUsesLocal: Left blank, this source runs on the local test cluster ({{target}}).
sparkCluster.blankUsesNone: Left blank, this source has no cluster to run on: {{detail}}
